title: Contextual Usage & Cost Insights
description: Deterministic token accounting and model pricing evaluations calculated completely offline on your device.
provenance.local_only: All token measurements are synthesized locally from session headers and operation logs. Zero prompts, code files, or telemetry are ever uploaded.
provenance.official_rates: Cost approximations apply official 2026 reference API pricing schedules ($ per 1M tokens) per model.
provenance.non_billing_estimate: Estimates are provided for developer planning only and should not be mistaken for official billing invoices.
